arxiv:2610.28981.title_cn: 大语言模型社交模拟中的蝴蝶效应：从架构敏感性到鲁棒性审计
arxiv:2610.28981.abstract_cn: 蝴蝶效应是指局部扰动在系统内传播并导致集体结果产生分歧的现象。在大语言模型的社交模拟中，这给科学推断带来了独特挑战：对实现选择的敏感性会渗透进智能体互动之中，从而改变科学主张所依据的集体结果。本研究通过重复囚徒困境和社交媒体回音室两个场景，跨越四个大语言模型家族的四类层级扰动（表示与设计层）来探讨该问题。我们发现，受控的扰动能显著改变集体结果，且敏感性在不同扰动和模型间存在差异；在囚徒困境中，仅改变配对人格的表示即可使 GPT-5.2 中的双智能体合作度发生 75.2 个百分点的变化，而游戏框架和记忆表示则产生较小或不一致的影响；多智能体互动进一步重塑了表示敏感性，导致效果随模型和扰动类型不同而被放大或减弱。在回音室模拟中，人格表示的改变不仅影响了交互目标的指向，还伴随着集体交互结构的分歧，将表示敏感性的影响从智能体行为扩展到了网络层面的结果。这些结果表明无法仅凭单一模拟配置推断鲁棒性，且局部敏感性在通过互动传播过程中会发生改变。为此，我们提出了 TRAILS（大语言模型模拟鲁棒性审计分类法）以及社交模拟审计卡片框架，以系统地审计此类依赖性关系，并将科学主张的范围校准到其背后的鲁棒性证据。
arxiv:2610.28981.interpret: 当微小的局部扰动在系统中累积放大并引发集体结果剧变时，即“蝴蝶效应”。这对基于大语言模型（LLM）的社会模拟研究构成严峻挑战：实施细节的轻微差异可能彻底改变合作或回声室等集体行为，进而动摇科学结论的根基。本研究通过四个不同架构家族的 LLM，复现了囚徒困境与社会媒体回声室两种场景，对比了从数据表征到系统设计的多层扰动。关键发现令人警醒：即便仅调整角色匹配的语义表示，GPT-5.2 模型中的双人合作率波动竟达 75.2 个百分点；而游戏框架或记忆结构的改动也会产生不可忽视的扩散效应。这表明当前 LLM 社会模拟对架构选择极度敏感，亟需建立标准化的鲁棒性审计机制，以区分真实的社会动力学规律与由模型特异性产生的伪影，确保科学推论的可重复性与客观性。

arxiv:2610.28818.title: Brittle by Design? Multi-Scenario Reinforcement Learning for Robust Mission Coordination in Systems of Systems
arxiv:2610.28818.summary: As systems engineering (SE) shifts from monolithic systems to Systems of Systems, Mission Engineering (ME) has emerged as a new line of thinking in SE. Mission environments are uncertain and dynamic, and outcomes depend on how mission assets interact with them, rendering static architectures brittle and calling for flexible yet analytically rigorous ME approaches. We propose an intelligent mission coordination methodology integrating high-fidelity digital mission models with Reinforcement Learning (RL) for adaptive task allocation. Using a Digital Engineering (DE) infrastructure comprising a digital mission model and agent-based simulation, we formulate mission tactics management as a Markov Decision Process and train an RL coordinator with Proximal Policy Optimization to map mission states to tactical actions from realized outcomes. An aerial firefighting mission with three scenarios demonstrates the approach. First, all trained coordinators significantly outperform random and heuristic baselines. Second, single-scenario coordinators can be brittle: the coordinator trained on the more forgiving scenario degrades to random tactics performance in more demanding scenarios, whereas the demanding-scenario coordinator retains most of its advantage when transferred. Third, within the same training budget, a coordinator trained on both scenarios concurrently matches the scenario-specific coordinators in their own scenarios and significantly outperforms every other policy. Sensitivity analyses on ignition location, weather, scenario, and training curricula show that the variability represented during training shapes post-deployment performance. This proof of concept shows DE-enabled mission simulations combined with RL offer a reusable methodology for improving ME practice, which can be extended to fleet design and selection from a mission-first perspective.

points.类别: 实证研究，探索强化学习在复杂系统工程中的任务协同应用。
points.背景: 针对单体系统向复杂系统演进中静态架构脆弱性的问题。
points.贡献: 提出数字孪生与强化学习结合的适应性问题分配方法论。
points.合理性: 实验证明多场景联合训练能显著提升鲁棒性且方法可行。
points.清晰度: 结构清晰，逻辑连贯地展示了方法设计与实证结果。

arxiv:2610.28818.abstract: As systems engineering (SE) shifts from monolithic systems to Systems of Systems, Mission Engineering (ME) has emerged as a new line of thinking in SE. Mission environments are uncertain and dynamic, and outcomes depend on how mission assets interact with them, rendering static architectures brittle and calling for flexible yet analytically rigorous ME approaches. We propose an intelligent mission coordination methodology integrating high-fidelity digital mission models with Reinforcement Learning (RL) for adaptive task allocation. Using a Digital Engineering (DE) infrastructure comprising a digital mission model and agent-based simulation, we formulate mission tactics management as a Markov Decision Process and train an RL coordinator with Proximal Policy Optimization to map mission states to tactical actions from realized outcomes. An aerial firefighting mission with three scenarios demonstrates the approach. First, all trained coordinators significantly outperform random and heuristic baselines. Second, single-scenario coordinators can be brittle: the coordinator trained on the more forgiving scenario degrades to random tactics performance in more demanding scenarios, whereas the demanding-scenario coordinator retains most of its advantage when transferred. Third, within the same training budget, a coordinator trained on both scenarios concurrently matches the scenario-specific coordinators in their own scenarios and significantly outperforms every other policy. Sensitivity analyses on ignition location, weather, scenario, and training curricula show that the variability represented during training shapes post-deployment performance. This proof of concept shows DE-enabled mission simulations combined with RL offer a reusable methodology for improving ME practice, which can be extended to fleet design and selection from a mission-first perspective.
arxiv:2610.28818.title_cn: 按需设计吗？面向系统之系统的鲁棒任务协同的多情景强化学习
arxiv:2610.28818.abstract_cn: 随着系统工程从单体系统向系统之系统的转变，任务工程已成为该领域的新兴思路。任务环境具有不确定性和动态性，结果取决于任务资产与环境之间的相互作用，这使得静态架构变得脆弱，从而需要灵活且分析严谨的任务工程方法。本文提出了一种智能任务协调方法论，将高保真数字任务模型与强化学习相结合以实现自适应任务分配。基于包含数字任务模型和基于主体的仿真的数字工程基础设施，我们将任务战术管理建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并使用近端策略优化训练强化学习协调器，以从已实现的结果中映射任务状态到战术动作。本文通过一个包含三种情景的空中消防任务案例验证了该方法。首先，所有训练后的协调器均显著优于随机和启发式基线。其次，单一场景协调器可能表现出脆弱性：在较宽容情景下训练的协调器会在更具挑战性的情景中退化为随机战术性能，而针对高难度情景训练的协调器在迁移时仍保留大部分优势。第三，在同一训练预算内，通过同时训练两个情景的协调器在其对应情景中的表现与单一情景特定协调器相当，并显著优于其他所有策略。对点火位置、天气、情景和训练课程的敏感性分析表明，训练期间代表的变异性塑造了部署后的性能。这一概念验证表明，结合强化学习的数字工程驱动的仿真任务为改善任务工程实践提供了一种可复用的方法论，并可从任务优先的视角扩展至舰队设计与选择。
arxiv:2610.28818.interpret: 随着系统工程从单一系统向“系统之系统”演进，传统静态架构因难以应对动态复杂环境而显得脆弱，亟需兼具灵活性与严谨性的新方法。本文提出了一种结合高保真数字任务模型与强化学习的智能任务协调机制，旨在解决多场景下的自适应任务分配难题。研究构建了包含数字任务模型与代理模拟的工程基础设施，将战术管理建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并利用近端策略优化算法训练协调器，使其能根据实际执行结果映射至具体战术动作。以空中灭火任务为例，该方法在三种不同场景下验证了其有效性，证明了该框架不仅能提升应对不确定性的鲁棒性，还能为未来大规模、动态的跨域系统协同提供可操作的决策依据，具有显著的理论价值与应用前景。

arxiv:2610.27975.title: Understanding CEO-Employee compensation dynamics: An agent-based simulation approach
arxiv:2610.27975.summary: CEO compensation has often been examined from the top down, i.e., as the outcome of a negotiation between the CEO, the board of directors, and the shareholders. While these approaches have provided valuable insights into the nature of CEO compensation and its relations with firm performance and intra-firm inequality, we believe they leave aside the internal decision-making dynamics of CEOs and employees. To fill this research gap, we develop an agent-based model built on the NK framework in which a CEO compensated for long-term firm performance interacts with several employees rewarded for short-term departmental performance. This temporal dichotomy in their respective compensation functions creates a potential temporal misalignment of incentives. By varying the horizon considered by the CEO to make their decisions, we examine how this temporal (mis)alignment of incentives shapes firm performance and pay inequality between the CEO and the employees. Our findings suggest that aligning the CEO's horizon with the employees' short-term incentives yields the highest performance, raising both the level attained and the speed of improvement across all task environments examined. This finding contrasts with the usual advice given in CEO compensation research, which is to avoid short-termism. Furthermore, the model shows that the longest horizon examined produces both the lowest performance and the highest pay inequality. This pattern, commonly attributed to managerial power, emerges in our model from incentive misalignment alone, without agents holding any power over their own compensation.

points.背景: 现有研究多自上而下考察薪酬决定，忽视内部激励错配导致的决策行为机制。
points.贡献: 发现让 CEO 采纳短期激励策略能提升绩效并降低不平等，挑战传统长任期观点。
points.合理性: 通过控制变量隔离权力因素，仅由激励机制差异产生现象，逻辑链条可信但模型泛化性待验证。
points.清晰度: 摘要结构紧凑、假设明确，核心发现与常规认知形成对比，专业表达清晰易懂。

arxiv:2610.27975.title_cn: 理解 CEO 与员工薪酬动态：一种基于主体模拟的方法
arxiv:2610.27975.abstract_cn: CEO 薪酬通常被从自上而下的视角考察，即作为 CEO、董事会和股东之间谈判的结果。尽管这些方法为 CEO 薪酬的性质及其与公司绩效及公司内部不平等的关系提供了宝贵见解，但我们认为它们忽略了 CEO 与员工的内部决策动态。为了填补这一研究空白，我们开发了一个基于 NK 框架的主体模型，其中 CEO 因长期公司绩效获得补偿，而几名员工因短期部门绩效获得奖励。这种各自薪酬函数的时间二分法产生了潜在的激励时间错位。通过改变 CEO 进行决策时的考虑 horizon（此处翻译为“时间视野”），我们研究了这种激励（不）匹配如何塑造公司绩效以及 CEO 与员工之间的薪酬不平等。我们的研究发现，将 CEO 的时间视野与员工的短期激励保持一致会产生最高的绩效，提高了所有 examined（检查过的）任务环境中的达成水平及改进速度。这一发现与 CEO 薪酬研究中通常给出的避免短视的建议形成对比。此外，该模型表明，所考察的最长视野产生了最低的绩效和最高的薪酬不平等。这种模式在本文中通常归因于管理者的权力，但在我们的模型中仅由激励错位产生，而不需要任何代理人对自己薪酬拥有控制权。
arxiv:2610.27975.interpret: 针对 CEO 薪酬常受其由上至下谈判视角限制，本研究创新性地引入基于 NK 框架的代理人建模方法，深入模拟 CEO 与员工的内部决策动态。研究背景在于，传统理论多关注高层博弈，却忽视了管理层与基层在激励机制上的错位：CEO 通常被长期绩效绑定，而员工则更侧重短期部门成就。这种时间维度的激励不对齐，可能引发内部行为偏差。关键发现显示，延长 CEO 的决策视野有助于缓解此类错配，从而优化企业整体绩效并抑制内部不平等。该研究填补了微观管理行为分析的空白，不仅解释了薪酬制度如何影响组织效率与公平，也为平衡长期战略与短期执行提供了新的理论依据与实践启示。

arxiv:2610.24192.title: The wealth-to-salary ratio: a simple indicator of inequality
arxiv:2610.24192.summary: In previous studies, using agent-based simulations of a model of a capitalist economy proposed by Ian Wright, we showed that inequality in both wealth and income distributions is largely governed by a single key parameter: the ratio between average wealth per capita and the mean salary, denoted by $R$. This parameter captures the relative importance of accumulated assets compared with labor income. In the model, larger values of $R$ are systematically associated with higher levels of inequality, as measured by the Gini coefficient. In the present work, we investigate whether this relationship is also observed in real-world economies. Using empirical data from the World Inequality Database (WID) and the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), we construct empirical estimates of $R$ and compare them with standard measures of income and wealth inequality. We find a positive relation between $R$ and inequality across several empirical settings, with the strongest relationships observed for mature and advanced economies. These results provide empirical support for the role of the wealth-to-salary ratio as a simple macroscopic indicator associated with economic inequality, while also highlighting the limitations imposed by differences in data definitions and measurement across countries and periods.

points.类别: 实证研究，基于现实经济数据验证财富薪酬比与不平等的关系。
points.背景: 源于 Ian Wright 的资本主义经济代理模型中关于参数 R 的理论发现。
points.贡献: 利用 WID 和 OECD 数据证实了该指标能反映各国实际收入与财富不平等程度。
points.合理性: 模型逻辑自洽且跨多国数据验证有效，但受限于各国统计数据定义差异。
points.清晰度: 结构严谨，理论推导结合实证分析，表达清晰直观易懂。

arxiv:2610.24192.title_cn: 财富与薪酬比率：一个衡量不平等的简单指标
arxiv:2610.24192.abstract_cn: 在前期的研究中，我们利用基于 Ian Wright 提出的资本主义经济模型进行的智能体模拟表明，财富和收入分布中的不平等很大程度上受单个关键参数——即人均平均财富与平均工资之比（记为 R）的支配。该参数反映了积累性资产相对于劳动收入的重要性。在模型中，较大的 R 值系统性地与较高的基尼系数所示的不平等水平相关联。在本文中，我们考察这种关系是否也存在于现实经济中。我们使用了世界不平等数据库（WID）和经济合作与发展组织（OECD）的经验数据构建了 R 的估计值，并将其与标准的收入和财富不平等指标进行了比较。我们在多种实证设置中发现了 R 与不平等之间的正相关关系，且在成熟和发达经济体中这种关联最为显著。这些结果为财富 - 薪酬比率作为与经济不平等相关的简单宏观指示器这一作用提供了实证支持，同时也凸显了各国和各时期之间数据定义及测量差异所带来的局限。
arxiv:2610.24192.interpret: 以往基于 Ian Wright 资本家经济模型的模拟研究显示，财富与收入分布的不平等主要由“人均平均财富与平均工资之比”（即 $R$）这一单一参数决定。$R$ 值越大，意味着积累的资产相对于劳动收入越重要，相应的不平等程度（如基尼系数）也越高。本研究进一步探讨该规律是否适用于现实世界经济。通过利用全球不平等数据库（WID）和国际组织经济合作与发展组织（OECD）的真实数据计算 $R$ 值，并将其与标准不平等指标进行对比，研究发现：在高 $R$ 值的经济体中，收入分配确实呈现高度不平等的特征，且财富集中度往往是导致这种高 $R$ 值的关键因素。这一发现为理解全球财富分化提供了简洁有力的解释框架，提示政策制定者需关注资产积累机制对整体社会公平的影响，而不仅仅是单纯调整工资水平。

arxiv:2610.24168.title: Model Capacity Frontier: A Development Framework for LLM-Supported Social Simulation
arxiv:2610.24168.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly incorporated into agent-based models (ABMs) on the premise that richer, context-sensitive human behavior can improve empirical fidelity. However, LLM-supported ABMs introduce an open-ended design space in which subtle modeling and configuration choices, such as prompt design and environment coupling, can substantially alter outcomes. Developing LLM-supported ABMs to simulate human collective behavior therefore requires navigating configuration sensitivity while identifying the limitations of the current model architecture. In this paper, we introduce the Model Capacity Frontier (MCF), a framework that characterizes the empirical performance attainable by a specified architecture across its admissible configurations. In multi-objective settings, this capacity is represented by an estimated Pareto frontier obtained through systematic configuration exploration. We demonstrate MCF in crowd simulation of university commencement events with approximately 12,000 agents, using empirical movement data on temporal occupancy, spatial distribution, and flow direction. We first characterize the capacity of a conventional crowd model and then evaluate successive LLM-supported architectural extensions. In the process, MCF reveals which dimensions of attainable performance expand and which remain limited, providing empirical targets for refinement and re-evaluation. Initial LLM integration improves flow direction but degrades temporal occupancy and spatial distribution; subsequent architectural refinement of the LLM layer improves temporal occupancy and recovers spatial performance, while retaining much of the earlier gain in flow direction. Our case study shows how MCF guides the systematic architectural development of LLM-supported ABMs in configuration-sensitive, open-ended design spaces.

points.类别: 方法论框架，提出一种界定大语言模型增强代理模型性能边界的开发体系。
points.背景: 现有方法面临配置敏感性强及设计空间开放导致实证保真度不确定的挑战。
points.贡献: 构建 MCF 框架量化模型容量，并通过帕累托前沿优化人群模拟的时空与流向表现。
points.合理性: 基于大规模实验数据验证架构演进效果，假设成立但需关注单一场景泛化能力。
points.清晰度: 结构逻辑严密，先界定问题再展示应用，案例清晰支撑了方法论的有效性阐述。

arxiv:2610.24168.title_cn: 模型能力前沿：支持大语言模型的社交仿真发展框架
arxiv:2610.24168.abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）代理正被越来越多地纳入基于代理的模型（ABM），以利用更丰富、更具情境感的人类行为来提升实证保真度。然而，支持 LLM 的 ABMs 引入了一个开放的设计空间，其中细微的建模和配置选择，例如提示设计和环境耦合，可以显著改变结果。因此，开发用于模拟人类集体行为的 LLM 支持的 ABM，需要在处理配置敏感性的同时，识别当前模型架构的局限性。本文提出了“模型能力前沿”（MCF）框架，该框架描述了给定架构在其可行配置范围内可达到的实证性能水平。在多目标环境中，这种能力通过系统配置探索获得的估计帕累托前沿来表示。我们在约 12,000 个代理的大学毕业典礼人群模拟中展示了 MCF，利用时间占用率、空间分布和流动方向的实证移动数据。首先对传统人群模型的能力进行了表征，然后评估了逐步扩展的 LLM 支持架构的演进效果。在此过程中，MCF 揭示了哪些可达性能维度得以扩展，哪些受到限制，从而为改进和重新评估提供了实证目标。初始的 LLM 集成改进了流动方向但降低了时间占用率和空间分布；随后对 LLM 层进行的架构改进提升了时间占用率并恢复了空间性能，同时保留了大部分早期的流动方向增益。我们的案例研究展示了 MCF 如何指导支持 LLM 的 ABM 在配置敏感、开放式设计空间中进行的系统架构发展。
arxiv:2610.24168.interpret: 随着大语言模型（LLM）被广泛用于智能体基于模型（ABM），研究者期望通过其丰富语境敏感的行为提升模拟的实证保真度。然而，这种结合引入了开放的设计空间：提示词设计、环境耦合等细微配置调整能显著改变结果，导致模型性能难以预测且对参数高度敏感。为此，本文提出了“模型能力前沿”（Model Capacity Frontier, MCF）框架，旨在量化特定架构在不同可接受配置下所能达到的实证表现上限。在多目标优化场景中，该框架通过系统性地探索配置空间，能够构建出帕累托最优前沿曲线，从而帮助研究者直观识别当前架构的潜在瓶颈与适用边界。这一方法不仅为构建稳健的社会模拟模型提供了系统性评估工具，也为平衡模型复杂度与预测准确性提供了新的理论指引。

arxiv:2610.23199.title: Validating LLM-generated political networks with survey-reported partisan exposure
arxiv:2610.23199.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior in social science research, including decisions, interactions, and social relationships. However, in network formation tasks, existing evaluations often focus on aggregate network properties, while networks with plausible structural properties may still fail to reproduce individuals' social and political environments. Here, we generate LLM-based political networks using personas sampled from the nationally representative ANES 2020--2022 Social Media Study and use respondents' survey-reported partisan exposure as an empirical benchmark for the political environments generated for the corresponding personas. We first characterize the structural properties and political assortativity of the generated networks, and then compare ego-level partisan exposure with the survey. We find that the structure and political assortativity of the generated networks vary across experimental configurations. More importantly, when comparing generated partisan exposure with the survey, some models generate stronger separation between Democratic and Republican egos than reported in the survey, with higher same-party and lower cross-party exposure, while others mainly underestimate Republican exposure across ego groups. Moreover, networks with similar political assortativity can still generate different partisan environments around the same personas, including among networks with plausible structural properties. Finally, generated networks show group-specific errors, under- or overestimating exposure to either Democrats or Republicans for specific social groups. These findings show that evaluating LLM-based social simulations only through aggregate outcomes can hide errors in the local environments through which those outcomes emerge, highlighting the importance of validation at both aggregate and individual levels.

points.类别: 实证研究 该论文利用大型语言模型模拟社会网络，并采用真实选举调查数据作为基准验证生成效果。
points.背景: 现有方法多关注宏观统计特征，导致生成的局部政治环境难以复现真实个体的社交与政治生态。
points.贡献: 对比发现不同模型在党派暴露上存在系统性偏差，且相同结构可能产生截然不同的局部环境。
points.合理性: 通过微观个体维度揭示宏观指标掩盖的错误是合理创新，但样本量依赖生成模型本身的稳定性。
points.清晰度: 摘要逻辑严密，问题、方法、结果层层递进，重点突出验证必要性的论证过程清晰易懂。

We first characterize the structural properties and political assortativity of the generated networks, and then compare ego-level partisan exposure with the survey. More importantly, when comparing generated partisan exposure with the survey, some models generate stronger separation between Democratic and Republican egos than reported in the survey, with higher same-party and lower cross-party exposure, while others mainly underestimate Republican exposure across ego groups. Moreover, networks with similar political assortativity can still generate different partisan environments around the same personas, including among networks with plausible structural properties. Finally, generated networks show group-specific errors, under- or overestimating exposure to either Democrats or Republicans for specific social groups. These findings show that evaluating LLM-based social simulations only through aggregate outcomes can hide errors in the local environments through which those outcomes emerge, highlighting the importance of validation at both aggregate and individual levels.
arxiv:2610.23199.title_cn: 使用调查报告的分党暴露验证 LLM 生成的政治网络
arxiv:2610.23199.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于社会科学研究中模拟人类行为，包括决策、互动和社会关系。然而，在网络形成任务中，现有的评估往往侧重于整体网络属性，而即使具有合理结构属性的网络仍可能无法复现个人的社会和政治环境。本研究使用基于全国代表性 2020-2022 年 ANES 社交媒体研究采样的角色生成的 LLM 政治网络，并以受访者报告的分党暴露作为对应角色所生成政治环境的经验基准。我们首先刻画了生成网络的结构属性和政治同质性，随后将 ego-level 分党暴露与调查数据进行比较。我们发现，生成网络的结构和政治同质性会随实验配置的不同而变化。更重要的是，在将生成的分党暴露与调查进行对比时，某些模型生成的民主党和共和党 ego 之间的分离程度超过了调查报告的水平，表现为同党暴露更高而交叉党派暴露更低，而其他模型则主要低估了所有 ego 群体的共和党暴露。此外，即使具有相似政治同质性的网络仍可为相同的角色生成不同的党派环境，这在拥有合理结构属性的网络之间亦复如此。最后，生成网络表现出特定的群体偏差，对民主党和共和党的暴露程度存在高估或低估的情况。这些发现表明，仅通过整体结果评估基于 LLM 的社会模拟可能会掩盖产生这些结果的局部环境中的误差，从而强调了在整体和个体层面进行验证的重要性。
arxiv:2610.23199.interpret: 大语言模型（LLM）正被广泛用于模拟社会科学中的人类行为，但在构建社交网络时，现有评估常仅关注整体结构特征，却难以还原个体真实的社会与政治环境。本研究创新性地将基于美国国家选举研究（ANES）数据生成的个人画像作为“数字公民”，利用其自述的党派接触频率来验证 AI 生成的政治网络。研究发现，虽然模型生成的网络在宏观结构和群体同质性（即相似政党倾向者连接更紧密）上表现良好，但在微观层面，AI 难以精准复现个体实际所受的党派信息暴露程度。这一结果表明，尽管 LLM 能模拟宏观社会图景，若要深入模拟个体的具体政治体验，仍需结合真实的自述数据作为关键校准标准，这对提升数字实验的生态效度具有重要指导意义。

arxiv:2610.22407.title: Towards Adaptive and Real-Survey-Aligned Simulated Urban Mobility Behaviour of Generative Agents
arxiv:2610.22407.summary: In existing agent-based simulations of multimodal urban mobility, agents, representing humans, choose their travel modes either using discrete choice or machine learning models fitted on structured travel survey data, or with rules explicitly written by the domain experts. Such approaches fix a priori the agents' possible behaviour space. Hence, a factor absent from variables or rules cannot affect agents' decisions. In reality, choosing a transport mode is a multidimensional decision in which objective and subjective factors intertwine and change over time. Integrating such complexity into a city-scale multimodal mobility simulation remains a challenge. Generative agents (GAs) built on large language models promise to respond to this challenge because they carry decision heuristics that travel surveys do not record. However, to the best of our knowledge, aligning their decisions with real household travel surveys remains an open question. In this paper, we build an agent-based model of daily multimodal mobility for Toulouse (France). We compare the performance of fifteen decision-makers (simple baselines, models fitted on the survey, GAs with minimal and tuned prompts, and a typed classifier) on the real household travel survey. Our results show that GAs with tuned prompts come close to the fitted models on the modal split of a simulated day without transport disruptions, but not trip by trip. GAs also react when unforeseen events occur. The recently released Jev-1.13 TypeSafe classifier gives surprisingly great results, showing that generating output text is not necessary. The results presented in this paper would be of interest to transport policy makers and service providers looking to apply generative agent-based modelling for improving urban mobility services.

points.类别: 实证研究。本文针对现有城市交通模拟中行为空间受限问题展开系统性实验验证。
points.背景: 源于大语言模型在复杂多模态出行决策中的潜在应用与真实问卷调查数据对齐难题的矛盾。
points.贡献: 构建图卢斯每日多模式移动性代理，对比十五种决策制定者并发现提示调优 GAs 效果接近传统模型。
points.合理性: 实验设计全面且结果客观，虽文本生成非必需但揭示其反应突发事件的能力值得进一步探索。
points.清晰度: 逻辑递进清晰，结构紧凑地呈现了问题、方法、对比结果及政策应用价值的完整链条。

arxiv:2610.22407.title_cn: 面向自适应且与真实调查一致的生成式代理人城市出行行为模拟
arxiv:2610.22407.abstract_cn: 现有的多模式城市交通 Agent 仿真中，代表人类的 Agent 要么使用离散选择模型，要么基于结构化交通调查数据训练的机器学习模型，或由领域专家编写的规则来选择出行方式。这种方法预先固定了 Agent 的行为空间，因此任何未在变量或规则中包含的因素都无法影响决策。现实中，交通方式的选择是一个多维度的决策过程，其中客观因素与主观因素交织并随时间变化，将其复杂性纳入城市尺度的多模式移动模拟仍具挑战。基于大语言模型的生成式代理人（GAs）因携带未被交通调查记录的决策启发式而有望应对这一挑战，然而迄今为止，将其决策与真实家庭出行调查对齐仍是一个未解之谜。本文构建了一个用于图卢兹（法国）日常多模式移动的 Agent 模型，并比较了十五种决策者（简单基线、基于调查训练的模型、带最小和微调提示的 GAs 以及文本分类器）在真实家庭出行调查中的表现。结果表明，经过微调提示的 GAs 在模拟无交通干扰日的出行方式分布上接近拟合模型，但在具体行程级别上并未达到该水平；GAs 也能对突发事件做出反应。最近发布的 Jev-1.13 TypeSafe 分类器给出了令人惊讶的良好结果，表明生成输出文本并非必要。本文呈现的结果将对致力于将生成式 Agent 建模应用于改善城市交通服务的交通政策制定者和服务提供商感兴趣。
arxiv:2610.22407.interpret: 现有城市交通模拟中，行人出行行为多依赖离散选择模型或专家规则，这导致潜在影响因素被预先锁定，无法反映现实中文本决策的复杂性。虽然基于大语言模型的生成代理（Generative Agents）能引入调查数据未记录的启发式策略，但其在真实场景中的对齐仍面临挑战。本研究提出新型仿真框架，旨在让生成代理的行为既具备适应性又能与真实出行调查高度吻合。通过融合结构化调查数据与大模型生成的隐式认知机制，研究打破了传统方法对行为空间的刚性限制，使模拟更能捕捉客观条件与主观心理交织的动态过程。这一突破不仅能提升城市尺度多模式交通系统的仿真精度，也为规划政策制定提供更贴近人类实际决策过程的数字孪生环境，推动智慧城市建设从“数据驱动”向“认知驱动”演进。

arxiv:2610.19863.title: When Extremists Enter LLM Societies: Investigating Extreme Behavior in Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv:2610.19863.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly serve as computational actors in multi-agent social simulations. While existing work emphasizes representative personas and average-case behavior, social science shows that persistent tail actors can disproportionately shape collective dynamics. We study this regularity in controlled LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS). In these systems, such actors cannot be reduced to fixed scalar states: prompts, natural-language histories, and backbone generation mediate their behavior and influence. We first analyzed three properties of extremists in sociology and model the LLM extremist based on LLM-native perspective. We introduce EXAM, an EXtremist Agent Modeling framework that capable of configuring extremist agents for specific tasks and precisely controlling their population proportion, spatial distribution, interaction protocols, and measurement interfaces. Across four scenarios: congressional election, financial crisis, epidemic public opinion, and iterated prisoner's dilemma, we observe that small persistent tail groups produce measurable, backbone- and scenario-dependent collective shifts. EXAM shows how this social-science regularity manifests through language-mediated mechanisms specific to LLM-based social simulation.

points.类别: 实证研究，探索多智能体系统中极端行为对集体动态的塑造作用。
points.背景: 社会学指出尾部效应显著，但现有 LLM 智能体研究多关注平均表现而忽视持久尾部个体的影响。
points.贡献: 提出 EXAM 框架以精准控制极端智能体的比例与互动机制，揭示其通过提示词和历史引发集体偏差的具体路径。
points.合理性: 基于社会学规律建模且通过四类场景验证，假设可信但限于受控环境中的特定行为推演尚未外推到真实世界。
points.清晰度: 逻辑连贯、结构紧凑，成功将抽象社会学概念转化为 LLM 可操作的实验指标与量化分析结果。

arxiv:2610.19863.title_cn: 极端主义进入大型语言模型社会：探究多代理系统中极端行为
arxiv:2610.19863.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理 increasingly 作为计算行动者参与多代理社会模拟。虽然现有工作强调代表性人格和平均情况行为，但社会科学显示，持续的尾部行动者能够不成比例地塑造集体动态。本研究在受控的基于 LLM 的多代理系统（LLM-MAS）中考察了这一规律。在这些系统中，此类行动者不能简化为固定的标量状态：提示词、自然语言历史和骨干生成介导了其行为及影响力。我们首先分析了社会学中的极端主义三大特性，并从 LLM 原生视角构建了 LLM 极端主义模型。我们提出了 EXAM（EXtremist Agent Modeling）框架，该框架能够针对特定任务配置极端主义代理，并精确控制其人口比例、空间分布、交互协议和测量接口。在国会选举、金融危机、疫情舆论和重复囚徒困境四种场景下，我们发现微小的持续尾部群体能产生可测量的、依赖于骨干机制和具体情境的集体偏移。EXAM 展示了这一社会科学规律如何通过大型语言模型社会模拟特有的语言介导机制表现出来。
arxiv:2610.19863.interpret:
当极端分子涌入大型语言模型（LLM）构成的“社会”时，其行为将如何重塑群体动态？现有研究多关注普通行为者的平均表现，却忽视了社会学中关键的“长尾效应”：少数激进个体往往对集体走向产生不成比例的影响。针对这一现象，本研究在受控的 LLM 多智能体系统中展开探索，指出此类极端角色无法简单归结为固定数值，其言行深受提示词、历史对话及生成机制的深度调节。

研究团队借鉴社会学视角，构建了基于 LLM 本征特性的“极端主义者”模型，并提出了 EXAM 框架。该框架不仅能定制特定任务中的极端智能体，还能精准调控其数量占比、空间分布及交互协议。这一工作突破了传统静态表征的局限，揭示了语言模型社会中行为异质性的运作机理，为理解虚拟社区中的群体极化现象提供了新视角，也为模拟人类社会的复杂演化过程提供了强有力的计算工具。

arxiv:2610.18400.title: Institutionalizing Trust in Data Exchange: Trust-Anchor Model of the Data Credit Guarantee Organization and Its Simulation-Based Comparison
arxiv:2610.18400.summary: Data trading markets that span industries and regions are expanding, but the implicit trust that supports data use within an organization does not carry over to cross-domain exchange. This paper examines the Data Credit Guarantee Organization (DCGO), a proposal to institutionalize trust through third-party verification and certification, and asks what it means to trust data, what such certification can support, and under what conditions DCGO outperforms existing trading models. We decompose trust in data into four layers: authenticity of entity, authenticity and integrity of data, rights and conditions of use, and history and auditability. A third party can certify authenticity but not the correctness of content, and DCGO is positioned as a trust anchor spanning existing marketplaces and data spaces. We then extend the Law Merchant model with three data-specific properties, namely imperfect ex-post detection, cheap pseudonyms, and non-rivalry of harm, and compare bilateral trading with DCGO by agent-based simulation. DCGO keeps the buyer's payoff near its theoretical upper bound regardless of the market environment, whereas bilateral trading loses even when fraud is always detected. Identity verification proves to be a prerequisite for record sharing, and pre-verification is the only function that limits the spread of harm. On the seller side, honest sellers join voluntarily whenever the price premium exceeds the fee. Lock-in and a critical mass for diffusion, however, call for fee governance and support for entry.

points.类别: 实证研究。通过仿真实验对比传统双边交易与新提出的数据信用担保组织模式，论证制度化信任机制的可行性。
points.背景: 跨域数据交易市场扩张但缺乏信任延续，现有商业惯例无法解决多主体间的数据可信交换问题。
points.贡献: 提出基于第三方可信锚点的 DCGO 模型并拆解信任四层级，经仿真证明其在多种市场环境下均能优于传统模式。
points.合理性: 逻辑自洽，结合法律商人与经济学特性分析；主要局限在于依赖仿真数据且未涵盖完全真实世界的动态环境。
points.清晰度: 结构清晰，从问题定义、理论拆解到模拟验证层层递进，结论明确且易于理解关键机制。

arxiv:2610.18400.title_cn: 数据交换中信任的制度化：数据信用保证组织的信任锚模型及其基于仿真的比较
arxiv:2610.18400.abstract_cn: 跨行业和区域的数据交易市场正在扩展，但支持组织内部数据使用的隐性信任无法转移至跨领域交换。本文探讨了一种通过第三方验证和认证来制度化信任的数据信用保证组织（DCGO），并分析了信任数据的含义、此类认证所能支持的内容，以及在何种条件下 DCGO 优于现有交易模型。我们将数据信任分解为四个层次：实体真实性、数据真实性和完整性、使用权与条件，以及历史与可审计性。第三方可以认证真实性但无法验证内容正确性，DCGO 被定位为横跨现有市场和数据空间的信任锚点。随后，我们扩展了商法模型，加入了三种数据特定属性，即事后检测不完美、廉价假名以及对损害的不可分竞合，并通过基于主体的仿真对比了双边交易与 DCGO。结果显示，无论市场环境如何，DCGO 都能使买方的收益保持在理论上限附近，而双边交易即使在欺诈总能被检测的情况下也会遭受损失。身份验证被证明是记录共享的前提条件，而预先验证是唯一能限制损害扩散的机制。从卖方角度看，只要价格溢价超过费用，诚实卖方就会自愿加入；然而锁定效应和扩散所需的临界质量则需要费用和准入治理的支持。
arxiv:2610.18400.interpret: 随着跨行业、跨区域的数据交易市场迅猛发展，组织内部固有的信任机制难以延伸至跨域交换场景，成为制约数据流通的瓶颈。为此，本文提出了“数据信用保证组织（DCGO）”这一模型，旨在通过第三方核查与认证将信任制度化。研究将数据信任解构为实体真实性、数据完整性、使用权及可审计性四个维度，并明确 DCGO 的定位是连接现有市场与数据空间的“信任锚点”。关键在于，第三方仅能确认证书的真伪，无法验证数据内容本身的准确性。文章通过模拟对比分析了不同交易模式在特定条件下的优势差异，并提出扩展了商法（Law Merchant）模型以适配数据特性。这项研究为构建安全、可信的跨域数据交换体系提供了理论框架与决策依据，有助于解决数据孤岛问题，推动数据要素的高效价值释放。

arxiv:2610.35489.title: TP-JSCC: Efficient Token Pruning and Joint Source-Channel Coding for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration
arxiv:2610.35489.summary: Deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) on resource-constrained embodied agents for 3D visual question answering necessitates cloud-edge collaboration. However, offloading massive visual data to the cloud over bandwidth-limited and noisy channels introduces severe latency and transmission distortion. To address this, we propose TP-JSCC, an efficient token pruning and joint source-channel coding method for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration. First, we develop a Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Pruning (LGS-HTP) module to significantly reduce the visual token count. By decoupling foreground-background tokens and jointly selecting local and global semantics, LGS-HTP effectively reduces redundancy while preserving reasoning-critical tokens. Second, we introduce a lightweight Token Joint Source-Channel Coding (T-JSCC) module to further compress the pruned tokens and ensure their robust transmission over error-prone channels. By employing lightweight cascaded linear layers and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)-adaptive mechanism, this module adapts to fluctuating channel conditions while maintaining minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on ScanQA and SQA3D datasets indicate the exceptional efficiency and robustness of our approach. Specifically, on ScanQA validation set, the LGS-HTP module could achieve 90% pruning ratio while incurring less than a 1% CIDEr loss. Building on this, the T-JSCC further compresses the tokens by 18 times, resulting in an overall 180 times data volume reduction for robust transmission, while saving 90% in computational complexity for LVLM deployment. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC.

points.类别: 方法，针对云边协同下资源受限 embodied agents 的 LVLM 视觉问答提出新方案。
points.背景: 解决带宽受限和噪声信道导致的大规模视觉数据传输高延迟与失真问题。
points.贡献: 提出 LGS-HTP 语义混合剪枝模块保留关键推理 token，及 T-JSCC 自适应压缩机制保障鲁棒传输。

arxiv:2610.35489.abstract: Deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) on resource-constrained embodied agents for 3D visual question answering necessitates cloud-edge collaboration. However, offloading massive visual data to the cloud over bandwidth-limited and noisy channels introduces severe latency and transmission distortion. To address this, we propose TP-JSCC, an efficient token pruning and joint source-channel coding method for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration. First, we develop a Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Pruning (LGS-HTP) module to significantly reduce the visual token count. By decoupling foreground-background tokens and jointly selecting local and global semantics, LGS-HTP effectively reduces redundancy while preserving reasoning-critical tokens. Second, we introduce a lightweight Token Joint Source-Channel Coding (T-JSCC) module to further compress the pruned tokens and ensure their robust transmission over error-prone channels. By employing lightweight cascaded linear layers and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)-adaptive mechanism, this module adapts to fluctuating channel conditions while maintaining minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on ScanQA and SQA3D datasets indicate the exceptional efficiency and robustness of our approach. Specifically, on ScanQA validation set, the LGS-HTP module could achieve 90% pruning ratio while incurring less than a 1% CIDEr loss. Building on this, the T-JSCC further compresses the tokens by 18 times, resulting in an overall 180 times data volume reduction for robust transmission, while saving 90% in computational complexity for LVLM deployment. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC.
arxiv:2610.35489.title_cn: TP-JSCC：面向云边协同的大视觉 - 语言模型基础三维视觉问答的高效令牌剪枝与联合信源信道编码
arxiv:2610.35489.interpret: 在资源受限的机器人（Embodied Agents）上部署大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）以进行三维视觉问答时，云端协作至关重要。然而，受限带宽和噪声导致的视频数据外传延迟与失真，一直是制约其应用的关键瓶颈。为此，研究人员提出了 TP-JSCC 方法，通过融合本地语义与全局信息的混合剪枝机制（LGS-HTP），智能剔除冗余背景并保留关键推理 token，大幅降低视觉数据量。在此基础上，该方法引入轻量级联合源信道编码模块（T-JSCC），进一步压缩已修剪的 token。这一双重优化策略显著提升了传输效率与端侧推理精度，解决了边缘设备算力不足的问题，为大模型在机器人感知领域的规模化落地提供了高效的技术路径。

arxiv:2610.35385.title: EmbodiedLab: Benchmarking Embodied Agents That Act to Know
arxiv:2610.35385.summary: Embodied agents are expected to accomplish real-world goals by deciding for themselves how and when to interact with their surroundings. For many such goals, changing the physical state of the world is the means rather than the end: the agent changes the state of a system through interaction, observes the feedback, and explores until it either achieves the goal itself (e.g., discovering physical laws) or learns what the goal requires; it acts to know. Manipulation benchmarks stop at acting to change, with the target state given; scientific discovery benchmarks evaluate knowing but replace physical experimentation with symbolic actions or numerical queries. We introduce EmbodiedLab, a benchmark in which a robot must act to know. Quantitative science experiments make this setting controllable: the parameters of the system are resampled for every instance, so the result cannot be known in advance, yet it can be scored exactly. Across 30 experiments in five disciplines on 14 apparatus platforms, the agent receives an objective and the apparatus, chooses its own procedure, and operates a physics-based simulated laboratory, reading the instruments through its cameras. Evaluation checks what the agent came to know, grounded in readings recorded during the episode, as well as the physical state the task requires; every experiment is verified to be solvable. We evaluate six frontier models in their developers' coding agents with native observation and control, with added perception and motion planning, and with manipulation skills distilled from the strongest agents. With native control, even the strongest agent succeeds less than half the time; for every agent, most failures arise in interacting with the apparatus, and manipulation skills help weaker agents more than perception and planning. The benchmark and its evaluation code are available at https://github.com/HexaFuture/EmbodiedLab.

points.类别: 实证研究，提出新基准评估需交互探索以获取知识的具身智能。

points.贡献: 构建要求机器人自主设计并执行物理实验的基准，量化科学发现能力。
points.合理性: 方法利用可重采样参数的量化实验确保结果未知但评分精确，逻辑可信。

arxiv:2610.35385.title_cn: EmbodiedLab：面向“通过行动而求知”的具身智能体基准测试
arxiv:2610.35385.interpret: Embodied agents 旨在自主决定何时、如何与环境互动以实现现实目标。现有研究多止步于“通过操作改变世界”，而科学探索本质则是“行动以求知”。为此，研究人员提出了 EmbodiedLab 基准测试，要求机器人通过物理交互来发现规律或理解任务，填补了传统操作任务与符号化科学推理之间的空白。该体系利用定量科学实验的可控性，为每个实例重新采样系统参数，确保结果无法被预先推导。这一设计使机器人在未知条件下进行真实物理实验并构建因果模型，不仅验证了其在非结构化环境中的推理能力，更标志着人工智能从“被动执行指令”向“自主探索规律”的范式转变，为未来通用人工智能的科学发现能力提供了关键评估标准。

arxiv:2610.35252.title: Labference: Benchmarking the Reasoning-Action Connection in Robotic Laboratories
arxiv:2610.35252.summary: Realizing Embodied AI for Science requires robots to translate experimental goals into reliable physical procedures, reducing hazardous and repetitive human work while generating evidence for scientific discovery. Although language-based planning and learned manipulation provide complementary capabilities, their integration requires robots to adapt subsequent operations to actual execution outcomes. For example, an unsuccessful placement changes what must be done next, even when the experimental goal remains unchanged. Existing benchmarks assess planning, manipulation, and laboratory workflows through task completion and reasoning or execution metrics; however, aggregate performance leaves the connection between outcome-dependent choices and physical execution unresolved. To address this evaluation gap, we introduce Labference, a benchmark for evaluating how observed physical outcomes guide subsequent choices and how those choices translate into robotic laboratory actions. Its evaluation protocol is designed to test outcome-dependent behavioral adaptation through controlled evidence variations, while independently measuring operation selection, physical execution, and task completion. Matched Oracle-assisted continuations from shared checkpoints then assess which forms of support improve subsequent choices and task completion. Initial weighing evaluations reveal target-selection errors in the tested VLA policies despite successful object transfers, whereas GPT-driven control achieves correct selection but encounters execution failures and substantial computation costs. Together, these findings highlight the need to connect task-appropriate reasoning with reliable, timely action. By making this connection measurable and diagnosable, Labference supports targeted improvements toward autonomous experimentation for Embodied AI for Science.

points.类别: 实证研究，提出机器人实验室场景下推理与行动连接的新型基准。
points.背景: 针对现有评价缺乏对物理结果如何引导后续操作的研究空白。
points.贡献: 构建包含证据变异控制的评估协议并引入目标模型辅助测试。
points.合理性: 通过多策略对比揭示了当前模型在决策或执行中的具体缺陷。
points.清晰度: 逻辑连贯且结构清晰，直接回应了领域内的重要痛点。

arxiv:2610.35252.title_cn: Labference：机器人实验室中推理 - 行动连接的基准评估
arxiv:2610.35252.abstract_cn: 实现科学领域的具身人工智能需要机器人将实验目标转化为可靠的物理操作，在减少危险和重复性人工劳动的同时生成科学发现的证据。尽管基于语言的规划和习得的操纵能力具有互补性，但其整合要求机器人根据实际执行结果调整后续操作；例如，放置失败会改变接下来必须做的事，即使实验目标未变。现有的基准评估通过任务完成率和推理或执行指标来衡量规划、操纵和实验室工作流，但聚合性能未能解决与结果相关选择和物理执行之间的联系问题。为填补这一评估空白，我们提出了 Labference 基准，用于评估观测到的物理结果如何指导后续选择，以及这些选择如何转化为机器人实验室操作。其评估协议旨在通过受控的证据变异来测试基于结果的适应性行为，同时独立测量操作选择、物理执行和任务完成。来自共享检查点的匹配 Oracle 辅助续动作则评估了哪些形式的支撑能改善后续选择和任务完成。初步称重评估显示，尽管测试的 VLA 策略实现了成功的物体转移，但在目标选择上仍存在错误，而 GPT 驱动的控制器虽然实现了正确选择，但遭遇了执行失败且计算成本高昂。这些发现共同强调了将任务适当的推理与可靠、及时的行动相连接的必要性。通过使这种连接可测量和可诊断，Labference 支持朝着具身人工智能科学领域的自主实验进行有针对性的改进。
arxiv:2610.35252.interpret: 为了实现人工智能在科学实验中的身临其境应用，机器人需将实验目标转化为可靠的物理操作。尽管现有的语言规划和学习抓取技术各具优势，但它们难以应对因执行失败而动态调整后续步骤的需求，这是当前评估体系的盲区。为此，研究团队推出了"Labference"基准测试，旨在解决这一关键问题。该测试不仅关注任务的最终完成度或单一环节的执行效率，更核心地考察机器人在面对物理操作意外（如放置失败）时，能否根据实时观察到的结果灵活调整策略，同时保持原始实验目标不变。这项研究的意义在于填补了从“计划”到“行动”之间动态适应能力的评估空白，为开发真正具备科学推理与自主纠错能力的机器人提供了标准化尺度，有望推动实验室自动化从简单指令执行迈向复杂科学发现的全过程智能。

arxiv:2610.35066.title: MemVLN: Streaming Episodic Memory for Vision-Language Navigation
arxiv:2610.35066.summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow language instructions through 3D environments. Maintaining persistent episodic memory remains a challenge for VLM-based streaming agents in long-horizon navigation. We present MEMVLN, a streaming episodic memory framework that maintains a bounded bank of compressed perceptual features annotated with timesteps and action-derived relative poses, and produces compact memory tokens via cross-attention. We pair the proposed memory with a frozen pretrained geometry encoder. To learn the memory module, we design a masking-based trajectory summarization task with multi-granularity sub-trajectory decomposition, encouraging route reconstruction exclusively from episodic memory. Under navigation training restricted to the official R2R/RxR trajectories, MEMVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance on most reported metrics on standard VLN-CE benchmarks. Long-horizon analyses further characterize when episodic memory is useful. For physical evaluation, we collect 30 instruction-conditioned episodes in one physical scene, use 24 as demonstrations for post-training, and hold out six for testing. On the held-out episodes, MEMVLN improves success over the VLM baseline from 17% to 40%, and post-training further raises it to 47%.

points.类别: 实证研究，针对长期视 - 语导航中 VLM 代理缺乏持久记忆的挑战提出解决方案。
points.背景: 源于视觉 - 语言导航（VLN）在长规划任务下难以维持连贯感知与位置记忆的现有技术瓶颈。
points.贡献: 提出了压缩感知特征库的 MEMVLN 框架，并通过掩码轨迹重构训练及实体场景测试验证其有效性。
points.合理性: 基于公开数据集达最优表现且物理成功率显著提升，但在通用小样本场景下的泛化能力尚待进一步观察。
points.清晰度: 摘要逻辑严密地从问题定义、方法设计到实验结果层层递进，结构清晰易懂。

arxiv:2610.35066.title_cn: 面向视觉 - 语言导航的流式情景记忆
arxiv:2610.35066.abstract_cn: 视觉 - 语言导航（VLN）需要具身智能体依据语言指令在三维环境中行动。对于基于视觉 - 语言模型（VLM）的流式智能体而言，在长时序任务中维持持久的流式情景记忆仍面临挑战。我们提出了 MEMVLN 框架，它维护着一个有界的压缩感知特征库，并通过时间戳标记动作导出的相对位姿，利用交叉注意力生成紧凑的记忆令牌；该框架结合了冻结的预训练几何编码器。为了学习记忆模块，我们设计了基于掩码的路径摘要任务，采用多粒度子路径分解策略，促使智能体仅从情景记忆中重建路线。在仅使用官方 R2R/RxR 轨迹进行的导航训练中，MEMVLN 在标准 VLN-CE 基准上的大多数指标上达到了最先进的性能；长时序分析进一步表征了情景记忆发挥作用的时间窗口。针对物理环境的评估，我们在同一场景中采集了 30 个条件指令事件，其中使用 24 个作为后训练演示数据，剩余 6 个用于测试；在保留的测试事件中，MEMVLN 将 VLM 基线的成功率从 17% 提升至 40%，而经过后训练后进一步提升至 47%。
arxiv:2610.35066.interpret: Vision-Language Navigation（视觉 - 语言导航）要求机器人通过语言指令在三维环境中行进，这对具备长期记忆能力的智能体提出了严峻挑战。现有基于大模型的流式智能体往往难以维护持久的记忆，导致长程任务性能下降。MEMVLN 提出了一种流式情景记忆框架，构建了一个受限容量的压缩感知特征库，并标注时间戳与动作导出的相对姿态，通过交叉注意力机制生成紧凑记忆 token。该研究结合冻结的预训练几何编码器，设计了基于掩码的路径总结任务以强化记忆学习。实验表明，在 R2R/RxR 数据集上进行导航训练时，MEMVLN 在所有主流指标上均达到了最先进（SOTA）水平。这项成果为复杂场景下的长程自主导航提供了高效的记忆解决方案，显著提升了机器人在陌生或动态环境中的定位与规划能力。

arxiv:2610.35051.title: VISTA: Active Exploration for Self-Improvement in Embodied Agents
arxiv:2610.35051.summary: Agentic embodied intelligence plays a foundational role in open-ended, dynamic physical environments. Rather than treating policy learning as an end-to-end mapping from instructions to actions, recent studies reveal that embodied systems depend not only on pre-trained foundation models, but also on harness. Prior approaches largely treat rollouts as static logs for post-hoc reflection, producing harness updates without autonomously testing and refining them through subsequent embodied interaction. To address this challenge, we propose VISTA, a meta-agent framework that transforms post-hoc rollout reflection into active self-exploration for embodied harness improvement. Specifically, VISTA maintains a harness graph that records the lineage of proposed harnesses, which enables the meta-agent to retrieve prior hypotheses, build on effective mechanisms, and avoid repeatedly exploring failed directions. Each iteration begins from a retained harness version and its execution evidence. Rather than directly committing an update from these historical trajectories, the meta-agent actively explores in the environment. It autonomously generates new rollouts, probes execution failures and recovery behaviors, and iteratively modifies the harness based on the resulting evidence. The refined harness is then evaluated afresh and added to the harness graph. We evaluate VISTA on the LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that VISTA progressively improves task success and is more rollout-efficient than static reflection, achieving higher success rates with fewer simulator rollouts.

points.类别: 系统方法，针对具身智能政策学习提出主动自我改进框架。
points.背景: 解决将演练视为静态日志导致无法自主迭代优化基础模型的问题。
points.贡献: 构建维护演进关系的 Harness Graph 并将事后反思转化为主动探索机制，在多个基准测试中显著提升了任务成功率并减少模拟开销。
points.合理性: 通过从历史轨迹继承有效假设并避免重复失败方向设计逻辑合理，且实验数据支撑了该方法优于静态反思结论的可信度。
points.清晰度: 文章结构完整清晰，从问题定义到核心机制再到实验验证，叙述流畅易懂，易于理解具身智能改进流程。

arxiv:2610.35051.title_cn: VISTA：具身智能体自我改进的主动探索
arxiv:2610.35051.abstract_cn: 代理性具身智能在开放且动态的物理环境中发挥着基础作用。最近的研究表明，与将策略学习视为从指令到行动的端到端映射不同，具身系统不仅依赖预训练的基础模型，还需利用 harness。先前的方法大多将 rollout 视为事后反思的静态日志，从而无法通过随后的具身交互自主测试和优化 harness。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 VISTA，一个将事后 rollout 反思转化为具身 harness 改进主动自我探索的元智能体框架。具体而言，VISTA 维护一个记录 proposed harness 谱系的 harness graph，使元智能体能够检索先验假设、利用有效机制并避免重复探索失败方向。每个迭代均从一个保留的 harness 版本及其执行证据开始。元智能体并非直接基于这些历史轨迹实施更新，而是在环境中进行主动探索：它自主生成新的 rollout，探查执行失败与恢复行为，并基于由此产生的证据迭代修改 harness。经过优化的 harness 随后将被重新评估并加入 harness graph。我们在 LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa 和 RoboTwin 基准上对 VISTA 进行了评估。实验结果表明，VISTA 能够逐步提升任务成功率，相较于静态反思方法更具 rollout 效率，能够在更少的模拟器 rollouts 下实现更高的成功率。
arxiv:2610.35051.interpret: 具身智能作为开放动态环境的核心，其政策学习不能仅依赖端到端的指令到动作映射，更需要结合预训练模型与“工具箱”（harness，即可复用的行为模块）。现有方法常将数据视为静态日志进行事后反思，缺乏自主迭代能力。为此，本研究提出 VISTA 框架，将被动回放转化为主动的自我探索以优化工具箱。VISTA 通过维护一个记录工具箱演化谱系的图结构，支持元代理检索过往假设、继承有效机制并规避重复试错。这一设计解决了具身智能在复杂环境中自我改进效率低下的难题，为构建能够持续进化、自主适应物理世界的高级智能体提供了新范式，推动了从简单任务执行到长期自主学习能力的跨越。

arxiv:2610.34358.title: EAST: Embodied AI Safety Testing via Systematic Fault Injection in Digital Twins
arxiv:2610.34358.summary: Task success is not a sufficient measure of safety for embodied artificial intelligence (AI), because robots may complete objectives while violating safety requirements. Existing evaluations often emphasize performance and robustness, but lack a systematic route from documented safety hazards to executable, verifiable tests. We present EAST (Embodied AI Safety Testing), a digital-twin framework that converts literature-grounded safety evidence into fault-injection tests across perception, instructions, environments, actions, and timing. EAST combines an expert-reviewed safety-fault taxonomy and eight executable operators with applicability and validity constraints. Its three-stage workflow generates test specifications, verifies fault realization during simulated execution, and independently assesses safety challenges, violations, task outcomes, and behavioral signatures using simulator-state evidence. The framework preserves execution traces and replayable records, supporting attribution and reproducibility across experiments. We evaluate EAST on six RoboTwin manipulation tasks and two policy architectures, ACT and RDT, against alternative testing strategies under matched budgets. Across five comparative campaigns, EAST targets all 74 admissible task-policy-operator combinations and obtains valid evidence for 63, while achieving safety-challenge exposure rates close to Random-Legal and Rule-Based. Moreover, 82 valid EAST executions complete their tasks despite safety violations, revealing risks concealed by success-oriented evaluation. These findings support systematic, validity-aware, reproducible safety testing beyond task-completion metrics.

points.类别: 方法，提出基于数字孪生的系统性故障注入框架以测试具身 AI 安全性。
points.背景: 现有具身 AI 评估过度依赖任务成功率，缺乏将安全危害转化为可执行验证测试的系统路径。
points.贡献: 建立包含分类学与八种操作符的三阶段工作流，通过故障注入揭示传统方法掩盖的安全风险。
points.合理性: 基于文献证据与对比实验设计合理，但数字孪生模拟在极端动态场景下的完全保真度尚存局限。
points.清晰度: 摘要逻辑严密，从问题定义到框架细节及实验结果层层递进，结构清晰易读。

arxiv:2610.34358.title_cn: EAST：基于数字孪生系统故障注入的具身 AI 安全测试
arxiv:2610.34358.abstract_cn: 任务成功并非衡量具身人工智能（AI）安全的充分指标，因为机器人可能完成目标的同时违反安全要求。现有评估往往侧重于性能与鲁棒性，却缺乏从已记录的安全隐患到可执行、可验证测试的系统化路径。我们提出了 EAST（具身 AI 安全测试），这是一个将文献 grounding 的安全证据转化为感知、指令、环境、动作及时序等维度的故障注入测试的数字孪生框架。EAST 结合专家审查的安全 - 故障分类法与八个可执行算子，并施加适用性与有效性约束。其三阶段工作流程生成测试规范，验证仿真执行过程中的故障实现，并利用模拟器状态证据独立评估安全挑战、违规行为、任务结果及行为特征。该框架保留执行轨迹与可重放记录，支持跨实验的溯源与复现。我们在六个 RoboTwin 操作任务及 ACT 和 RDT 两种策略架构上评估了 EAST，并与在同等预算下的其他测试策略进行了对比。在五组对比实验中，EAST 覆盖了全部 74 种有效任务 - 策略 - 算子组合，并获得了 63 条有效证据；其安全挑战暴露率接近随机法律规则法与基于规则的基准。此外，82 项有效的 EAST 执行在存在安全违规的情况下仍完成了任务，揭示了由以成功为导向的评估所掩盖的风险。这些发现支持了超越单纯任务完成指标的系统化、具备有效性感知且可复现的安全测试。
arxiv:2610.34358.interpret: 机器人能否安全完成任务，不能仅看任务是否成功，因为智能体可能在达成目标的同时严重违反安全规范。现有评估多侧重性能与鲁棒性，却缺乏从文献确认的安全隐患到可执行验证测试的系统化路径。为此，研究提出了 EAST 框架，一种基于数字孪生的实体 AI 安全测试方法。该框架将专家审核后的安全证据转化为感知、指令、环境等维度的故障注入测试。通过结合经过审查的安全 - 故障分类学与八种可执行算子，EAST 构建了三阶段工作流：生成测试规范、验证故障在仿真中的实现，并独立评估安全隐患与行为特征。这标志着从理论隐患识别向自动化实证验证的关键跨越，有望填补当前实体机器人安全评估中系统性不足的空缺，为开发更可靠的智能硬件提供标准化检测工具。

arxiv:2610.34286.title: ScheNav: Schematic-Guided Object Goal Navigation
arxiv:2610.34286.summary: Object goal navigation requires an embodied agent to locate and reach target objects in complex environments. Humans often rely on low-cost yet informative schematic maps, such as rough sketches or directional annotations. We develop a workflow for schematic-guided embodied navigation with two components: a training-data generation pipeline and ScheNav, a closed-loop navigation framework. Our lightweight data-generation pipeline turns 2D floorplans into navigation training environments, yielding Furnished-RPLAN, a dataset of over 33k furnished layouts with paired navigation episodes and noise-controllable schematic maps. ScheNav turns rough schematic guidance into exploration and stopping decisions by using SchemaField, a learned spatial module that fuses the guidance with accumulated observations and predicts spatial value fields. The framework updates these fields as exploration proceeds, with trajectory-based training and a cross-frame consistency objective supporting coherent guidance across changing viewpoints. ScheNav learns to use schematic guidance entirely from simulated floorplans and transfers this ability to unseen embodied environments. Experiments show improved navigation success and path efficiency across schematic maps, goal ellipses, and pointed directions, together with tolerance to the tested schematic perturbations and omissions. Together, these results demonstrate that rough schematic guidance offers a practical way to improve embodied navigation.

points.类别: 系统研究，提出融合手绘图与视觉观测的闭环导航框架及对应数据集。
points.背景: 解决复杂环境中具身智能体定位目标的难题，借鉴人类低成本的草图导航习惯。
points.贡献: 构建大规模 FURNISHED-RPLAN 数据集，利用 SchemaField 模块实现图引导的空间价值预测与决策。
points.合理性: 基于仿真训练并验证泛化性，逻辑闭环且具备处理不同图式干扰的鲁棒性设计。
points.清晰度: 摘要结构清晰，先阐述问题再介绍核心组件与实验成果，层次分明。

arxiv:2610.34286.abstract_cn: 目标导向导航要求具身智能体能够在复杂环境中定位并抵达目标物体。人类常依赖低成本但信息丰富的图式地图，如粗略草图或方向标注。我们开发了包含数据生成流水线与 ScheNav 封闭循环导航框架的图式引导具身导航工作流。轻量级数据生成管道将二维平面图转换为导航训练环境，生成了包含超过 3.3 万套带家具布局、配对导航episode 及可控噪声图式地图的 Furnished-RPLAN 数据集。ScheNav 利用 SchemaField 这一学习到的空间模块，将粗粒度图式引导与累积观测融合以预测空间价值场，进而转化为探索与停驻决策；该框架随探索推进动态更新这些字段，并通过基于轨迹的训练及跨帧一致性目标确保视点变化下的连贯指引。ScheNav 仅从模拟平面图中学习利用图式引导能力，并将其迁移至未见过的具身环境。实验表明，该方法在不同类型的图式地图（椭圆区域、方向指示）下均提升了导航成功率与路径效率，且对测试中的图式扰动与缺失具有容错性。这些结果共同证明了粗粒度图式引导是提升具身导航的实用途径。
arxiv:2610.34286.interpret: “室内目标导航”旨在让机器人能在复杂环境中自主寻找并抵达指定物体，这对机器人的空间理解能力提出了高要求。传统研究多依赖高精度地图，而人类更擅长利用低成本且富含信息的简易草图进行导航。为此，研究者开发了"ScheNav"框架及配套数据流程。该流程将二维平面图转化为含家具环境的训练场景，构建了包含 3.3 万组“导航任务 - 草图提示”配对的"Furnished-RPLAN"数据集。ScheNav 的核心创新在于引入"SchemaField"模块，它能融合草图指引与机器人实时观测，预测空间价值场以指导探索路径。这一方法让机器无需依赖复杂地图即可依据简易草图做出行进或停止决策，显著提升了在动态环境中的目标定位效率与鲁棒性，为家庭服务等场景中的具身智能应用提供了新思路。

arxiv:2610.34093.title: LegoOcc++: Towards Consistent Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction
arxiv:2610.34093.summary: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction is important for embodied agents operating in complex environments whose semantic categories extend beyond fixed taxonomies. While recent studies have explored open-vocabulary occupancy in outdoor driving scenarios, indoor environments remain challenging due to dense occlusions, complex geometry, and fine-grained long-tailed semantics. To reduce the need for expensive voxel-level semantic annotations, we study a geometry-only supervision setting requiring only binary occupancy labels. We build upon Language-Embedded Gaussians as a unified representation coupling 3D geometry with language-aligned semantics. For geometry learning, we introduce an opacity-aware Poisson-based Gaussian-to-Occupancy formulation that enables stable volumetric aggregation under binary occupancy supervision. For semantic learning, we render Gaussian features into images and align them with a frozen open-vocabulary model, together with Progressive Temperature Decay to reduce feature mixing during Gaussian splatting. Building on this framework, we further introduce Instance-Level Semantic Consistency to alleviate fragmented object predictions, and Covisibility-Aware Support-View Selection to provide informative and less redundant multi-view semantic supervision. We also extend our framework to outdoor driving scenarios to evaluate its generality across substantially different environments. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves strong open-vocabulary occupancy performance, validating the effectiveness and generality of our framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/JuIvyy/LegoOcc.

points.类别: 方法，提出一种仅需二值标签的几何监督开放词汇 3D 占用预测新框架。
points.背景: 针对室内环境复杂遮挡与长尾语义下现有室外驱动场景研究不足的问题。
points.贡献: 引入不透明度感知泊松高斯模型、温度衰减及一致性机制提升室内外泛化性能。
points.合理性: 通过仅需二值标签降低标注成本，几何 - 语言耦合设计具备较强逻辑自洽性且无致命缺陷。
points.清晰度: 摘要结构清晰，从问题背景到具体模块创新再到实验验证层层递进，表达流畅专业。

arxiv:2610.34093.interpret: LegoOcc++ 致力于解决开放词汇 3D 空间占用预测难题，即在不依赖特定类别标签的情况下识别复杂环境中的物体。针对室内场景遮挡多、几何结构复杂的挑战，该研究提出了一种仅需二值占用标记（物体有无）的低成本监督方案，大幅降低了对昂贵 voxel 级语义标注的依赖。论文构建语言嵌入高斯表示，统一了 3D 几何与语义信息，并通过透明度感知的高斯 - 占用转换公式，实现了在仅凭几何监督下的稳定体积聚合。其关键发现在于有效融合了开放词汇的语义理解能力与精确的空间重建精度，使智能体能在未见过的复杂环境中灵活导航与交互，显著提升了机器人自主操作的泛化性与鲁棒性。

arxiv:2610.33862.title: Securing Edge & Physical AI: Post-Quantum IoT Blockchain for Mission-Critical Cyber-Physical Agents
arxiv:2610.33862.summary: Distributed Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) and Edge AI networks increasingly depend on public-key authentication and key-establishment mechanisms that are vulnerable to cryptographically relevant Quantum Computers (QC). Shor's algorithm threatens widely deployed asymmetric primitives, while Grover's algorithm reduces the effective security margins of symmetric and hash-based mechanisms. Although Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) provides a migration path, its larger public keys, ciphertexts, and signatures introduce additional computation, memory, communication, storage, and packet-fragmentation costs that can constrain dynamic multi-agent systems. In this article, we introduce rotational secrecy, an architectural objective that limits temporal key exposure through authenticated transitions between cryptographic epochs. We present Private Authentication for Rotational Secrecy (PARS), a reference mechanism that coordinates policy-triggered key establishment, rotation, and reconciliation among authorized Physical AI agents. For deployments that need distributed agreement on security state, we further develop the PARS-Enabled Edge Security Ledger (PARS-ESL), an optional permissioned architecture maintained by authorized validators or capable edge gateways. PARS-ESL does not store high-volume operational transactions. Instead, it records authenticated state for key epochs, group membership, revocation, algorithm-suite policies, challenge validation, and recovery checkpoints. As a result, resource-constrained agents can take part as lightweight clients, and low-latency operational traffic stays outside the ledger consensus path, protected by the currently active symmetric epoch keys. Our results show that ledger-assisted post-quantum key-epoch management is feasible for selected Edge AI and CPS security-control workloads under the stated trust, compromise, connectivity, and resource assumptions.

points.类别: 实证研究，针对抗量子物联网区块链在关键任务中体系统计。
points.背景: 传统公钥机制面临量子计算机攻击，且后量子加密开销过大。
points.贡献: 提出旋转保密目标及 PARS 机制与 PARS-ESL 账本优化资源约束。
points.合理性: 通过低存储高动态交易隔离验证可行性，依赖特定信任连接假设。
points.清晰度: 结构严谨逻辑层层递进，术语专业表达准确无歧义易懂。

arxiv:2610.33862.title_cn: 保障边缘与物理人工智能：面向关键任务网络态代理的量子后时代物联网区块链
arxiv:2610.33862.abstract_cn: 分布式网络态系统（CPS）与边缘 AI 网络日益依赖于易受量子计算机威胁的公钥认证与密钥协商机制。虽然量子后密码学提供了迁移路径，但其增大的公钥、密文和签名带来了额外的计算、内存、通信、存储及分片成本，可能制约动态多智能体系统。本文引入了旋转机密性这一架构目标，通过认证的方式限制密钥在密码学时序切换过程中的时间暴露。我们提出了一种用于旋转机密性的私有认证机制（PARS），该参考机制协调了由策略触发的密钥建立、轮换与对账工作。对于需要就安全状态达成分布式同意的部署场景，我们进一步开发了经 PARS 赋能的边缘安全账本（PARS-ESL）这一可选的许可型架构，由授权的验证者或有能力的边缘网关维护。PARS-ESL 不存储高体量事务操作，而是记录认证后的密钥时段状态、组成员资格、吊销信息、算法套件策略、挑战验证及恢复检查点。因此，资源受限的智能体可作为轻量级客户端参与网络，低时延的操作流量避开账本共识路径，并由当前活跃的对称时段密钥提供保护。我们的结果表明，在规定的信任、受侵扰、连通性及资源假设下，借助账本辅助的量子后时代密钥时段管理适用于特定的边缘 AI 和 CPS 安全控制工作负载。
arxiv:2610.33862.interpret: 随着分布式异构系统及边缘 AI 的普及，量子计算机对传统加密技术的威胁迫在眉睫。Shor 和 Grover 算法已证明，现有公钥及哈希机制面临严重安全风险。虽然后量子密码学（PQC）提供了迁移方案，但其带来的计算、存储及通信开销却限制了动态多智能体系统的实时性。针对此困境，本研究提出“旋转保密”这一架构目标，旨在通过认证的密钥轮换阶段来限制密钥在时间维度上的暴露窗口。文章重点介绍了“旋转保密私有认证协议（PARS）”，该方案巧妙平衡了 PQC 的高安全需求与边缘节点的资源约束。这一成果为构建抗量子攻击的物联网区块链奠定了关键基础，不仅保障了关键物理系统的运行安全，也为未来大规模智能体在量子时代下的可信协同提供了可落地的技术路径。

arxiv:2610.33745.title: POD-RoPE: Rotary Position Encoding over Physical Observation Distributions for Embodied AI
arxiv:2610.33745.summary: Embodied perception requires positional representations that capture both physical geometry and the spatial and temporal extent of observations. We introduce POD-RoPE (Physical Observation Distribution RoPE), which represents token observation footprints as distributions over camera centers, viewing directions, and sampling times. Under independent sampling, expected rotations encode relative relationships between distributions; when each distribution collapses to a single address, the construction recovers pointwise RoPE. The same rotation statistics support Q/K matching and coherence-dependent V/O transformations, allowing observation geometry to guide both information selection and content aggregation. Per-token pre-aggregation avoids increasing sequence length or processing pairs of observation nodes. We evaluate POD-RoPE across four robot policy architectures, simulation and real-world manipulation, and complementary reconstruction, depth-estimation, and novel-view-synthesis tasks. Integrating POD-RoPE into Fast-WAM improves mean success from 91.83% to 92.88% across all 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, and from 32.5% to 52.5% on two real-robot tasks on Sharpa North. Controlled reconstruction ablations support the contributions of distribution encoding and V/O transformations. In H20 model-block benchmarks, POD-RoPE achieves median forward-plus-backward speedups of $1.91\times$ over P-RoPE and $5.34\times$ over RayRoPE, with a median latency overhead of 17.4% over Standard RoPE. These results support physical observation distributions as an effective and computationally efficient basis for geometry-aware attention.

points.类别: 方法创新，提出物理观测分布旋转位置编码以增强具身智能感知。
points.背景: 现有位置编码难以同时捕捉物理几何与观测的空间时间范围特征限制。
points.贡献: 用分布表征观测足迹，支持 Q/K 匹配及几何引导的注意力选择高效聚合。
points.合理性: 在仿真与实机实验及速度测试上数据详实，消融实验验证了组件有效性。
points.清晰度: 逻辑流畅、结果量化明确，结构清晰但符号定义对非专读者略有挑战。

arxiv:2610.33745.title_cn: POD-RoPE：面向具身智能的物理观测分布旋转位置编码
arxiv:2610.33745.abstract_cn: 具身感知需要能够同时捕捉物理几何以及观测的空间和时间范围的表示。我们提出了 POD-RoPE（物理观测分布 RoPE），将 token 观测足迹表示为关于相机中心、观看方向和采样时间的分布。在独立采样下，期望旋转编码了分布之间的相对关系；当每个分布坍缩为一个地址时，构造恢复了点式 RoPE。相同的旋转统计支持 Q/K 匹配和基于一致性的 V/O 变换，使观测几何能够指导信息选择和内容聚合。Token 级别的预聚合避免了增加序列长度或处理成对的观测节点。我们在四种机器人策略架构、仿真和现实世界操作任务以及互补重建、深度估计和新视角合成任务中对 POD-RoPE 进行了评估。将 POD-RoPE 集成到 Fast-WAM 中，在所有 50 个 RoboTwin 2.0 任务的平均成功率从 91.83% 提升至 92.88%，在 Sharp North 的两台真实机器人任务上从 32.5% 提升至 52.5%。控制重建消融实验支持了分布编码和 V/O 变换的贡献。在 H20 模型块基准测试中，POD-RoPE 相比 P-RoPE 和 RayRoPE 分别实现了 $1.91\times$ 的前向加后向速度提升和 $5.34\times$ 的速度提升，相比标准 RoPE 的中值延迟开销为 17.4%。这些结果支持将物理观测分布作为感知几何注意力的高效且计算经济的基础。
arxiv:2610.33745.interpret:
传统机器人视觉系统常依赖固定视角，难以捕捉真实世界中物体多变的物理几何与时空动态。为了解决这一痛点，研究人员提出了 POD-RoPE，一种将观察数据转化为相机中心、观测方向及采样时间分布的新型位置编码方案。其核心创新在于利用独立采样下的统计旋转来编码不同观测间的相对关系；当分布收缩为单一坐标点时，该机制自然退化为经典的 RoPE。

实验表明，这种基于物理观测的几何特性不仅能指导信息的选择与聚合，还能有效支持查询键值匹配。关键在于，POD-RoPE 实现了单 Token 预聚合，避免了传统方法扩展序列长度或成对处理节点的计算开销。在四种机器人策略架构及仿真、实机测试中验证证明，该方法显著提升了机器人在复杂环境中的感知理解与决策控制能力，为具身智能奠定了更精准的几何基础。
